question: Will Kstovo be back to full output within a month, yes or no?

lines.text: Lukoil's Kstovo refinery is on fire after a drone attack, the third Russian refinery hit in three days.
Governor Gleb Nikitin says an industrial facility in Kstovo district sustained significant damage.
He did not name it. Ukrainian media say it is Lukoil's refinery.
Russia's defence ministry says it downed two hundred and thirty five drones nationwide.
The plant can process seventeen million tonnes of crude a year.
Ukrinform says it supplies fuel to the Moscow region and to Russia's armed forces.
The regional government urged drivers to fill up as needed, without creating a rush.

scene.quote: as needed, without creating a rush

lines.text: Since Friday, drones also hit refineries in Novokuibyshevsk and Ufa, media report.
Russian outlet Agentstvo says the three plants handle about ten percent of Russia's refining.
On Thursday, the Wall Street Journal reported a pause in refinery strikes until the US midterms.
But Zelensky said his units do not have an order to stop.
Will Kstovo be back to full output within a month, yes or no?
